## Contribution rules for tektoncd/pipeline

- Disclose AI assistance in the PR description. (https://github.com/tektoncd/community/blob/HEAD/ai-contribution-policy.md#L34)
- An `Assisted-by: <agent>/<model>` commit trailer is an accepted way to disclose. (https://github.com/tektoncd/community/blob/HEAD/ai-contribution-policy.md#L31)
- Run the tests locally before opening or updating the PR. (https://github.com/tektoncd/community/blob/HEAD/ai-contribution-policy.md#L11)
- Be able to explain every line of the change yourself. (https://github.com/tektoncd/community/blob/HEAD/ai-contribution-policy.md#L49)
- Keep PRs small and focused; split large AI-generated changes. (https://github.com/tektoncd/community/blob/HEAD/ai-contribution-policy.md#L47)
